project_name: Golden Pirates Recruit Portal - Espaces Recrue (Royaume 1023)
app_type: Pirate Web App & Recruitment Portal (React JS + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion)
design_archetype: Gothic Nautical & Tactical Pirate Command Center
theme: Dark Velvet & Gold Parchment (Ink #06090E, Gold #D4AF37, Bone Parchment #F5EFE0, Crimson #8B0000)
target_audience: Recruits, Pirates, Council Officers, Kingdom 1023 Members across Desktop, Tablet, iOS, and Smartphone
key_problems_addressed: Eliminated vertical stack chaos (~8 long blocks collapse together)
Modular Tabbed & Grid Architecture (Status & Dossier, Council Bottle Chat, Recruits Den, Bottle Shelf)
Added explicit sorting (Trier par date, statut, nom, puissance) and quick search filters across all lists
Enhanced button states, active feedback, accessible hit targets, and clear visual hierarchy for mobile/tablet/desktop
Restored functionality & clarity for re-applications, sanctuary cooldowns, code lookup, and peer messaging

headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-normal tracking-wide text-[#D4AF37] drop-shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]

mono_code.classes: font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-amber-300 font-bold bg-[#0D131F] px-2 py-1 rounded border border-[#D4AF37]/30

layout_and_navigation.header: Sticky translucent pirate navigation bar with backdrop-blur-md, kingdom status pill, countdown tag, brand mark, and desktop/mobile quick tabs

suivi_page_architecture.mode: Modular Tabbed Hub with Top Quick Search Bar
suivi_page_architecture.top_bar: Search tracking code GP-1023-XXXX with high contrast INTERROGER button + Collapsible recovery panel toggle

tab_navigation.label: Mon Statut & Dossier
tab_navigation.content: Status badge, Discord acceptance banner / sanctuary cooldown, 6 detailed dossier fields, Council notes, Re-application trigger

tab_navigation.label: Bouteille à la Mer
tab_navigation.content: Council direct messaging channel, real-time feel chat, message deletion, status indicators

tab_navigation.label: Tanière des Recrues
tab_navigation.content: Peer search by pseudo, power sorting, filter tabs, active recruit list with chat modal/drawer

tab_navigation.label: Étagère à Bouteilles
tab_navigation.content: Device saved codes grid/list, quick filter (Actif / Archivé), VOIR, Retirer, and POSTULER À NOUVEAU actions

suivi_page_architecture.notifications_drawer: Floating gold parchment notification bell & side panel for latest kingdom announcements

component_guidelines.buttons: Custom gold-bordered pirate buttons (`bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#B89028] text-[#06090E] font-bold shadow-lg hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200 border border-[#FFF0A5]/40`). NEVER use default blue or plain gray buttons.
component_guidelines.inputs: Parchment-tinted dark inputs (`bg-[#0A0F18] border border-[#D4AF37]/40 text-[#F5EFE0] placeholder-[#F5EFE0]/40 focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] px-4 py-3 rounded-md font-mono text-sm shadow-inner`).
component_guidelines.cards: Textured dark leather & parchment panels with metallic gold corner trims or 1px stroke border (`bg-[#0F1622] border border-[#D4AF37]/30 rounded-lg p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden`).
component_guidelines.badges: Custom status pills: Accepté (Emerald Green #1B4D3E + Gold text), En Examen (Gold #D4AF37 + Dark text), Refusé (Sanctuaire Crimson #8B0000 + Parchment text).

sorting_and_filtering_controls.recruits_den: Sort selector: [Dernière activité, Puissance de combat (max->min), Statut, Alphabetique], Search input for pseudo
sorting_and_filtering_controls.bottle_shelf: Sort selector: [Date de sauvegarde, Statut de la candidature, Code GP], Filter buttons: [Tous, Validés, En attente, Refusés]

motion_and_effects.tabs: Smooth Framer Motion tab switcher (`layoutId='activeTab'`, smooth fade-in and scale-in 0.2s)
motion_and_effects.micro_interactions: Haptic scale feel on hover/tap (`whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}`, `whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}`)

testing_attributes.mandatory: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, sort dropdowns, and status badges MUST include data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are working in a React JS environment (.js and .jsx files). Do NOT use TypeScript type annotations.
Do not keep the vertical 8-block stack on /suivi page. Reorganize into a clean tabbed/bento UI hierarchy so users never lose their place.
Make sure all action buttons (VOIR, Retirer, POSTULER À NOUVEAU, Chat recrue, Interroger le registre, Replier) work seamlessly with clear state feedback.
Implement real sorting dropdowns and filter buttons for the Recruits' Den and Bottle Shelf lists.
Maintain the immersive pirate brand identity (Ink #06090E, Gold #D4AF37, Parchment #F5EFE0, Gothic typography, leather card panels).
Ensure total responsiveness across Smartphone (iOS/Android touch hit targets >= 44px), Tablet, and Desktop displays.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for testing verification.
